translations.rule: GEOX POS (probability of geological success) maps directly to p_technical_success in WEALTH EMV computation. No discount applied — POS is the geological input.
translations.default_assumption: POS from GEOX prospect analysis, typically 15-60% for frontier prospects
translations.if_wrong_cost: EMV error proportional to (ΔPOS × NPV_upside + ΔPOS × NPV_downside). At POS 35%, ±10% error → EMV error ~±RM 8M for a RM 80M well.

translations.rule: GRV × porosity × formation factor = STOOIP. Apply recovery factor (RF) to get reserve estimate. RF from analog fields, typically 25-45% for clastic reservoirs.
translations.default_assumption: Porosity 18%, Sw 35%, RF 30% from Sabah analog dataset
translations.if_wrong_cost: Reserve estimate error = GRV error × porosity × RF. 20% GRV error → ~15% reserve error → NPV error ~±RM 12M.

translations.rule: Bulk density affects mud window and well design. Higher density → narrower mud window → more casing strings → higher cost. Use Halliburton / Schlumberger regional rate tables for Sabah shallow water.
translations.default_assumption: Shallow water jack-up rate USD 85K/day, 45-day campaign = USD 3.8M per well
translations.if_wrong_cost: 10% capex overrun on USD 15M well = USD 1.5M direct cost, plus 6-month delay at USD 85K/day = additional USD 15.3K/day.

translations.rule: HIGH seismic confidence → no discount rate uplift. MEDIUM → +1% discount rate. LOW → +2-3% discount rate. CRITICAL uncertainty → EVOI computation required.
translations.default_assumption: Seismic confidence MEDIUM (2D/3D mix) → +1% discount rate adjustment
translations.if_wrong_cost: +1% on 10-year NPV reduces PV by ~8%. On a USD 50M project NPV, this is USD 4M.

translations.rule: DOE/JAS EIA approval timeline adds direct delay. Apply to project timeline. Delay costs: additional overhead + opportunity cost + possible PSC timeline extension.
translations.default_assumption: 18 months from submission for Sabah offshore (DOE EIA mandatory under Environmental Quality Act 1974)
translations.if_wrong_cost: 6-month delay on USD 50M capex at 10% WACC = USD 2.5M PV loss.

translations.rule: GEOX PSC terms (royalty rate, PTP rate) directly enter WEALTH fiscal model. Apply to gross revenue to get government take, then compute contractor NPV.
translations.default_assumption: Sabah PSC: 38% royalty floor, 38% PTP (after cost recovery)
translations.if_wrong_cost: PSC terms are contractual — wrong assumption is a factual error, not a risk parameter. Mis-stating PSC terms is a TIER_3 epistemic error.

translations.rule: 2C reserve × realized price × realized recovery factor × (1 - royalty - pttp) / (1 + WACC)^t = reserve PV. Use realized price = Brent × Malaysia price premium (~2-5%).
translations.default_assumption: 2C 180 MMbbl × USD 82/bbl realized × 30% recovery / (1.10)^5 = ~USD 135M contractor NPV before capex
translations.if_wrong_cost: Reserve estimate is the largest driver of NPV sensitivity. ±30% reserve → ±40% NPV.

note: A seismic confidence value does NOT automatically become a WEALTH risk-discount rate. This card governs the typed transformation. Without it, WEALTH reasons on prose.
